opening.argument: The presentation presents OneCoin as a market opportunity through an educational program, then promotes a token-return proposition by claiming participants can double their portfolios in less than ten weeks. It also links recruitment directly to compensation, offering a solid reward for building a team and establishing a downline income structure. The appeal is reinforced by scarcity: viewers are told that positions are limited, alongside an immediate push to register and join the network. Taken together, these features form a direct solicitation built around promised token growth, recruitment rewards, and tiered participation rather than neutral discussion.
